title: sqlc-gen-richmodel options
description: Configuration schema for the `options` block passed to the sqlc-gen-richmodel codegen plugin (spec 001-model-generation-config). Version 1 is the only supported schema version; an unrecognized or missing `version` MUST fail generation (FR-008).

version.description: Required configuration schema version. Generation fails if missing or not exactly 1.

contexts.description: Ordered list of bounded contexts. Declaration order is preserved into generated output order (FR-018).

package.description: Go package identifier of the sqlc-gen-go output, used in generated imports.

import.description: Go import path of the sqlc-gen-go output package.

driver.description: Initial supported baseline is pgx/v5 only; other values fail generation.

name.description: Diagnostic/identity label. Must be unique across contexts.

package.description: Go package name shared by all generated files in this context.

directory.description: Output directory, relative to the plugin's output root.

models.description: Model name -> ModelConfiguration. Object key order MUST be preserved by the decoder (FR-018, FR-011) even though JSON Schema itself cannot express key-order preservation.

row.description: Canonical sqlc row/result type used to hydrate the model.

operations.description: Lifecycle operation -> sqlc query name. `insert` is required; other operations are optional (an unconfigured operation generates no corresponding method).

fields.description: Field name -> FieldPolicy. Object key order MUST be preserved by the decoder; this is the order surfaced by FR-011 (DirtyFields(), struct field order).

generated.description: Absent means not database-generated. `insert`: populated only from the insert RETURNING row. `save`: may be repopulated on both insert and update.

column.description: Explicit database column override; skips automatic name matching.

row_field.description: Explicit sqlc result-field override; skips automatic name matching.

value_object.description: Explicit mapping from the persisted sqlc column type to a developer-owned value object exposed by the generated model.

type.description: Go type expression exposed by generated model APIs.

constructor.description: Function called with the persisted sqlc value during hydration; expected to return (valueObject, error).

accessor.description: Method called on the value object to produce the persisted sqlc value for query parameters.

allOf.description: A field the database generates cannot also be part of the new-model assignment API.
